title: The demo was copied onto a mini-program as soon as it was released: an AI-developed indie game claws back two rounds thanks to Chinese players

content_html:
In October 2025, a young man who could neither program nor draw decided to make a game. His first instruction to AI was, “Make a block game that can move with WASD.” A year later, this one-person team called Optima Arch turned Slotbound into a smash hit: it launched on November 13 at 42 yuan with a 10% launch discount; six days later, sales exceeded 200,000 copies, revenue approached ten million yuan, it had over 1,800 reviews with about an 80% positive rating, and peak concurrent players reached 33,000.

AI Paints the Skin, the Human Writes the Bones
